name: Slingshot
author: supercleanse
description: Your newest downloads and screenshots, one click away. A bar icon drops down the latest files in Downloads and Pictures, with thumbnails. Drag one onto a terminal to type its path, onto a browser or chat app to attach it, or onto a file manager to copy it; click to copy it to the clipboard. The list updates as files arrive. An optional slingshot-ssh wrapper makes drops work over SSH: the file is uploaded to the remote machine and its remote path is typed.

barWidget.description: Tray icon for your latest downloads and screenshots. Click it for the newest files in Downloads or Pictures, then drag one onto any app, or click it to copy. A dot appears when a new file lands.

schema.label: Show a dot when a new file arrives
